crossRefs.note: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it…
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the…
But the miry places of it, and its marshes, will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

translations.web: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
translations.bsb: I made the wilderness his home and the salt flats his dwelling.
translations.kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
translations.asv: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the salt land his dwelling-place?
